question.text: Investors at the time of income earning may be different from investors at distribution time in Cat III AIF because:

answer.text: Multiple secondary transfers change the investor pool; this creates tax attribution complexity

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.6, multiple secondary transfers in Cat III AIF units change the investor composition — income earners and income receivers may differ. **The Trap:** Other statements don't match reality. **Cross-Exam Context:** Critical tax-attribution issue in Cat III AIFs. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Maintain detailed unit register to track transfer timing and investor-attributable income.
